title: Photo Album for Boyfriend: Ideas for a Gift He'll Actually Open | Albums.ink
desc: Photo album for boyfriend ideas for a birthday, anniversary or Christmas: what to include, captions, voice notes and how to make an online photo album gift for free.
h1: Photo album for your boyfriend: ideas for a gift he'll actually open
lead: A photo album is one of the few gifts that gets better the longer you've been together. But a printed book takes weeks and most of your best photos are on your phone anyway. Here are photo album ideas for your boyfriend — for a birthday, an anniversary or Christmas — and how to turn them into an online album with your own voice that he can open from a link.
body: ## What to put in it
- Your first photo together and the story of how you met.
- First date, first trip, first Christmas — the “firsts” always work.
- Inside jokes: the pub quiz you lost, the train you missed, the takeaway order you always get.
- Places that matter: your local, the beach in Brighton, the city break in Edinburgh.
- Screenshots of your first messages, if you dare.
- Videos: short clips say more than any caption.
## Ways to structure the album
- Timeline: one chapter per year or per season of your relationship.
- “Reasons I love you”: one photo with one reason per page.
- Places: one chapter for every trip or city.
- Birthday edition: one chapter per birthday you've spent together.
## Caption ideas
- “The day you pretended you knew the way.”
- “Still my favourite person to do nothing with.”
- “Proof we were cute before the coffee.”
## Add your voice
A short voice note on the best photos — how you felt that day, what he said — turns a slideshow into a gift. He can play the album as a slideshow with your narration.
## Make it online for free
On Albums your gift is a story album: photos, videos and voice notes in chapters, with your voice narration. It's free, with no ads, and the album stays as long as you want it.
1. Sign in with Google and create an album, e.g. “Us, so far”.
2. Add chapters by year, trip or theme.
3. Upload photos and videos; record voice notes in the browser or upload audio files.
4. Set it to private and add him as a person who can see it — or share a link with a cover preview.
5. Send the link on the day, or open it together as a slideshow.

Photos up to 30 MB, videos up to 50 MB and audio up to 20 MB per file. You can download the whole album as one ZIP file at any time.

faq: What should I put in a photo album for my boyfriend?
Your first photo together, firsts like dates and trips, inside jokes, places that matter and short videos, with a caption or voice note on the best ones.
How do I make an online photo album for my boyfriend?
Create a story album, add chapters, upload photos and videos, record voice notes and share the link privately with him.
Yes. Story albums on Albums are free, with no ads. Photos up to 30 MB and videos up to 50 MB per file.
Can he see it without an account?
A public album opens from a link without signing in. For a private album he needs to sign in so you can give him access.
